integrity: A self-contained symbolic substitution proof is supplied. A finite executable corroborates, but does not imply, the infinite statements. No independent scientific audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Exact factor maximum and abelian complexity are established at every dyadic length, and only order of growth is established for arbitrary lengths. No unconditional unrestricted-length prefix-normality or full nondyadic formula is claimed. An equivalent unindexed prior result cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact dyadic abelian complexity and Fibonacci growth of the Baum–Sweet word
